title: Melee Afflictions
summary: Melee Afflictions is a Melee Arcane that adds additional stacks to existing Status Effects on enemies that are knocked down or flung by melee attacks.
extract:
Melee Afflictions is a Melee Arcane that adds additional stacks to existing Status Effects on enemies that are knocked down or flung by melee attacks.

Effect

Acquisition
Melee Afflictions can be obtained from Ascension's optional Sister of Parvos, summoned by acquiring 3 Sister Beacons during the elevator ride. Alternatively it can be purchased from Ordis in the Drifter's Camp for 10  Vestigial Motes, for a total of 210 for max rank.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Damage Calculation
For damaging status effects, each time  Melee Afflictions is triggered, the damage of each added stack is calculated as follows. There are 4 main parts, 1. Damage of individual Status procs, 2. The average of all Status procs for each Status Effect, 3. The sum of all the average Status Effect damage, 4. The calculation of new Status Effect damages for procs that are present on the target.

For each Status proc find the Modded Base Damage of every Status proc on the enemy for each Status Effect type.
Proc MBD (Modded Base Damage)=Weapon Base Damage×(1+Weapon Base Damage Bonus)×(1+Weapon Faction Damage Bonus)×(1+Weapon Status Damage Bonus)×(Additional Multipliers)
Additional Multipliers include modded critical multiplier on Critical Hit and multipliers on Enemy Body Parts; these stack multiplicatively with each other.
Note that Faction Damage Bonuses only apply once from the source weapon of the status. The "double dip" is not counted.
For each Status Effect type, sum the damage of all Status Effect procs is used to find the damage of that Status Effect.
Status Effect Average Damage=[Sum Of All Proc MBDsNumber Of Status Procs]
Affliction Damage Hit is the instance of damage caused by  Melee Afflictions and is the sum of all of the Status Effect Average Damage and multiplied by melee Faction Damage Bonuses.
Affliction Damage Hit=(Slash Status Effect Average Damage+Heat Status Effect Average Damage+Toxic Status Effect Average Damage+Electricity Status Effect Average Damage+Gas Status Effect Average Damage)×(1 + Melee Faction Bonuses)
Affliction Damage Hit is used to find the Damage Over Time of all Status Effect types present. Modifiers that are consider are the same as the normal calculation for respective Status Effect types. Faction Damage Bonuses, and Status Damage Bonuses that are present on the melee weapon are applied to Status Effects.
Affliction Damage Tick of Status Effect =Affliction Damage×Status Effect Multiplier×(1+Melee Faction Damage Bonus)×(1+Melee Status Damage Bonus)×(1+Elemental on Melee of Status Effect (where applicable))
Only  Toxin and  Electricity statuses can benefit from Elemental Damage Bonuses.
 Heat damage will not benefit from Elemental and Faction Damage Faction Damage Bonuses on the melee weapon, unless the melee weapon was the source of the first heat status on the enemy. See Heat Inherit.
 Blast does use Affliction Damage to calculated the damage of new status procs are added by  Melee Afflictions.

Trigger
 Knockdown,  Lifted, or  Ragdoll procs will not trigger  Melee Afflictions depending on the enemy state. See the table below for the known interactions as of Update 39.0 (2025-06-25).

(1)  Slash Dash can knockdown Frozen targets and still trigger Melee Afflictions.

Notes
Status Effects from any source can be affected by this arcane, including statuses applied on the attack that triggered  Melee Afflictions.
 Toxin and  Electricity mods can increase the damage of the stacks added by  Melee Afflictions.  Heat mods cannot.
Faction Damage Bonuses and Status Damage Bonuses can highly increase the damage from  Melee Afflictions.
These bonuses exponentially scale. Probably a bug.
When equipped on Exalted weapons,  Melee Afflictions:
can stack  Arcane Impetus
can stack  Arcane Ice Storm
can trigger  Archon Vitality, however Archon Vitality doesn't double but adds only one additional stack (from +6 to +7).
can trigger  Archon Continuity on targets afflicted by toxin (only results in 1 stack of  Corrosive).
can trigger  Archon Stretch on targets afflicted by electric.
does not trigger  Archon Flow by stacking  Cold.

Tips
Stances that can force  Ragdoll are the most efficient at triggering this arcane since it can ignore most control effects that otherwise would prevent Afflictions from activating.
Slams and Heavy Slams are excellent at force proccing  Lifted or  Knockdown.
 Gas is very effective at scaling with  Melee Afflictions, since it is capped at 10 stacks and new procs override older ones, which always leaves the 10 strongest stacks possible. This can be used to quickly scale other damaging status effects alongside it.
 Blast is best used to do big instances of damage once Damage Over Time status effects have had some damage built up.
 Heat is best used to compound the damage on enemies because of Heat Inherit.
Combined elemental mods on your Melee like modded  Magnetic,  Corrosive, and  Viral can still apply elemental bonuses to  Toxin, and  Electricity .  Heat must be applied by the weapon to use elemental mods. Incarnons or other weapons that forces  Heat to proc can use combined elements mods on  your melee like  Gas,  Blast, and  Radiation for elemental bonuses to Heat  damage.

Bugs
 Lifted procs add 12 stacks instead of 6.
